# Draft:Military ranks of the Ethiopian Empire

The Military ranks of the Ethiopian Empire were the military insignia used by the Army of the Ethiopian Empire. The insignia fell out of use after the army was disbanded in 1974 by the Derg.
In 1996, the insignia was chanced to that of the modern military ranks of Ethiopia.
